fields.name: TrustedPath UAC Bypass Pattern
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (tgt.process.image.path contains "C:\\Windows \\System32\\" or tgt.process.image.path contains "C:\\Windows \\SysWOW64\\"))
